 We have 13 K-drama releases lined up for the week of November 16-22, 2026, and there is plenty to add to your watchlist. We start with the premieres of The Blue Road, Good Partner 2 and Crash Season 2, followed by kiDnap GAME, Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Merry Berry Love, The Remarried Empress, The Perfect Lie, Final Table, Oh! My Guard, Sword & Silence and 100 Days of Deception. These Korean dramas bring a mix of crime thrillers, courtroom drama, romance, historical intrigue, suspense and culinary competition to platforms including Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and more. The K-drama releases this week, November 16-22, include The Blue Road, Good Partner 2, Crash Season 2, kiDnap GAME, Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Merry Berry Love and 100 Days of Deception. The lineup brings cross-border crime, legal drama, romance, palace intrigue, mystery and culinary competition to streaming platforms such as Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and more.  Looking for new K-drama OTT releases this week (November 16-22)? The lineup features Netflix's Korean-Japanese crime thriller The Blue Road, Jang Na-ra and Kim Hye-yoon's Good Partner 2, and Lee Min-ki's returning series Crash Season 2. Alongside these premieres, several ongoing Korean dramas are releasing new episodes, including kiDnap GAME, Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Merry Berry Love, The Remarried Empress, The Perfect Lie, Final Table, Oh! My Guard, Sword & Silence and 100 Days of Deception. From crime and legal dramas to historical romance and culinary competition, here is what to watch on OTT this week.
 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Nov 16-22)
 The Blue Road (Netflix): Nov 20
 Son Suk-ku plays Kim Seok, a Seoul detective who teams up with Tokyo’s Inose (Eita Nagayama) after a body turns up in Tokyo with a message scrawled in Korean. Soon, a Korean case answers back in Japanese. Kim Shin-rock, Jung Jae-young and Choi Sung-eun round out the cast.
 Good Partner 2 (SBS): Nov 20
 Jang Na-ra returns as Cha Eun-kyung, who leaves Daejeong to run Re-bom Law Firm and partners with Kim Hye-yoon’s devoted divorce lawyer, Kang Hye-sung. Park Hae-jin arrives as a rival and Pyo Ji-hoon returns. Writer Choi Yu-na and director Seo Min-jung steer 16 episodes.
 Crash Season 2 (ENA): Nov 16
 Director Park Joon-woo’s Traffic Crime Investigation team is now a national unit, no longer tied to Namgang Police Station. Lee Min-ki and Kwak Sun-young return, joined by Jisung as newcomer Ji Dae-sae.
 kiDnap GAME (Disney+): Nov 17
 Episode 7 of the thriller, in which one kidnapping unfolds across seven cities and seven desperate players. Lee Joon-gi and Sakaguchi Kentaro lead.
 Love in Disguise (Prime Video): Nov 16-17
 Episodes 9 and 10 of the office romance-thriller, in which Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as the male secretary of a chaebol heir suspected of murder.
 Summer Vacation (Viki): Nov 16-17
 Episodes 7 and 8 return to Upo Village, where student Kim Ha-yeon (Cho Yi-hyun) meets the landowner’s son, Jo Yu-gyeom (Jin Young).
 Merry Berry Love (Disney+): Nov 18
 Episode 7 continues the story of Ji Chang-wook’s burnt-out designer and Imada Mio’s strawberry farmer, who heal each other on a remote Japanese island.

 Episodes 7 and 8 deepen the palace triangle of Shin Min-ah’s Navier, Ju Ji-hoon’s emperor and Lee Jong-suk’s shape-shifting prince.
 The Perfect Lie (Disney+): Nov 20-21
 Episodes 7 and 8 of Yoo Yeon-seok and Seo Hyun-jin’s psychological thriller, where two people remember one event very differently.
 Final Table (Prime Video): Nov 21-22
 Ahn Hyo-seop’s chef Kang Han faces The Table: K-Chef 2026 in episodes 9 and 10, while Choi Song-yi guards her late father’s legacy.
 Oh! My Guard (Viu): Nov 21-22
 Episodes 9 and 10 set actor Uhm Tae-bong’s public image against the secrets of the enigmatic Oh Hae-ra.
 Sword & Silence (KBS2 / Wavve): Nov 21-22
 Episodes 3 and 4 trace Kim Beop-min’s late seventh-century push to unify the peninsula, with Lee Hyun-wook, Jang Hyuk, Kim Kang-woo and Park Sung-woong.
 100 Days of Deception (Netflix): Nov 21-22
 Episodes 13 and 14 of the 1932 Gyeongseong spy romance, with Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young as a pickpocket-turned-agent and an interpreter.
